facebook_post.label: Facebook post: 1 image (1080x1350) in a post format (question, scene, did you know, tip or Roman); text rendered by the app; rotates between packages

facebook_ad.label: Facebook ad: 3 variants of one ad with the person (headline, subheadline, CTA button)

linkedin_post.label: LinkedIn post: 1 square image (1080x1080) in a post format (stat, split, framework, Roman quote or the classic layout); text rendered by the app

instagram_carousel.label: Instagram carousel: 6-8 static PNG slides (1080x1350, no people) in a post format (checklist, mistake/fix, myth/fact or steps): cover, body slides, a closing question; caption, hashtags and alt text

reel_short.label: Short vertical video (reel), up to 90 s

ugc_ad.label: UGC-style video ad, up to 60 s

podcast_clip.label: Podcast clip: the person's own HeyGen avatar speaks the script, with optional b-roll, up to 90 s
